user.title: Choose setup method
user.description: Use the Tibber fast track when Tibber supplies both your Pulse measurements and electricity contract. Choose custom or mixed sources for every other combination.

data_description.setup_method: The fast track discovers known Tibber entities automatically. The custom path keeps measurement and price sources independent.

manual.title: Set up custom or mixed sources
manual.description: Select measurement and price sources independently.

data.price_included_components: Components already included in the price
data.grid_fee_per_kwh: Variable grid fee per kWh (including VAT)
data.grid_fee_high_per_kwh: High-period grid fee per kWh (including VAT)
data.tax_per_kwh: Additional tax or markup per kWh (including VAT)
data.fixed_supplier_fee_monthly: Fixed monthly electricity supplier fee (including VAT)

data_description.power_entity: Required sensor providing the current power.
data_description.price_entity: Optional sensor providing the current electricity price.
data_description.pricing_strategy: Required when a price sensor is selected. Choose how that sensor's price is produced.
data_description.price_included_components: Required when a price sensor is selected. Select every variable component already contained in the sensor value; Market energy must be included.
data_description.price_vat_treatment: Required when a price sensor is selected. State whether its value includes VAT.
data_description.energy_entity: Optional sensor providing today's accumulated energy consumption.
data_description.accumulated_cost_today_entity: Optional sensor providing today's accumulated electricity cost.
data_description.peak_power_today_entity: Optional sensor providing today's maximum measured power.
data_description.current_l1_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous current for phase L1.
data_description.current_l2_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous current for phase L2.
data_description.current_l3_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous current for phase L3.
data_description.voltage_l1_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous voltage for phase L1.
data_description.voltage_l2_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous voltage for phase L2.
data_description.voltage_l3_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous voltage for phase L3.
data_description.monthly_peak_hour_consumption_entity: Optional sensor providing monthly peak hour consumption.
data_description.monthly_peak_hour_time_entity: Optional timestamp sensor providing when the monthly peak hour occurred.
data_description.grid_fee_per_kwh: Optional: Grid fee in the same currency per kWh as the selected price sensor, including VAT. In Sweden, this is typically 0.10–0.35 SEK/kWh, depending on the grid provider.
data_description.grid_fee_high_per_kwh: Optional: Add a high-period fee to enable a weekday high/low tariff. The ordinary grid fee above is then used as the low-period fee.
data_description.grid_fee_high_start: Local start time for the high fee on Monday–Friday, for example 06:00.
data_description.grid_fee_high_end: Local end time for the high fee on Monday–Friday, for example 22:00.
data_description.grid_fee_high_season_start: First date of the recurring high season, written MM-DD; for example 11-01.
data_description.grid_fee_high_season_end: Last date of the recurring high season, written MM-DD; for example 03-31.
data_description.tax_per_kwh: Optional non-negative additional tax or markup in the same currency per kWh as the price sensor, including VAT. For most Swedish households, the 2026 energy tax is 0.45 SEK/kWh.
data_description.fixed_supplier_fee_monthly: Optional fixed monthly fee charged by the electricity supplier, including VAT. Do not enter grid-company fixed fees or capacity charges.
data_description.good_price_threshold: Optional: Maximum Effective Price considered a good time to use electricity, in the same currency per kWh as the selected price sensor. For example, use 0.90 SEK/kWh for a Swedish setup.
data_description.forecast_nordpool_config_entry: Optional native Nord Pool integration used for forecast retrieval. Its configured area and currency are inherited automatically.

tibber.title: Select Tibber home
tibber.description: Select the Tibber home whose Pulse measurements and electricity contract Electricity Pro should use.

tibber_settings.title: Confirm Tibber fast track
tibber_settings.description: Electricity Pro found {entity_count} compatible entities. Current power: {power_entity}. Contracted price: {price_entity}. Tibber's contracted price includes market energy, Tibber markup, Swedish energy tax, and VAT. Add only costs that are not included, such as your variable grid fee.

data_description.grid_fee_per_kwh: Optional: Grid fee in the same currency per kWh as the Tibber price, including VAT. In Sweden, this is typically 0.10–0.35 SEK/kWh, depending on the grid provider.
data_description.grid_fee_high_per_kwh: Optional: Add a high-period fee to enable a weekday high/low tariff. The ordinary grid fee above is then used as the low-period fee.
data_description.grid_fee_high_start: Local start time for the high fee on Monday–Friday, for example 06:00.
data_description.grid_fee_high_end: Local end time for the high fee on Monday–Friday, for example 22:00.
data_description.grid_fee_high_season_start: First date of the recurring high season, written MM-DD; for example 11-01.
data_description.grid_fee_high_season_end: Last date of the recurring high season, written MM-DD; for example 03-31.
data_description.good_price_threshold: Optional: Maximum Effective Price considered a good time to use electricity. For example, use 0.90 SEK/kWh for a Swedish setup.
data_description.fixed_supplier_fee_monthly: Optional fixed monthly fee charged by Tibber or another electricity supplier, including VAT. It does not affect Effective Price or scheduling insights.
